page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.13xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs derived from 26 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 25%. However, the high core count compensates in multi-threaded scenarios, delivering average performance in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only large block speeds at 101.16 GB/sec and write large block speeds at 36.51 GB/sec, both falling into the middle 50% tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a high density of dedicated vCPUs relative to its memory footprint, making it a viable option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive RAM arrays. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications such as software compilation, static web serving, and database operations. The lack of local storage and weak single-core performance are key tradeoffs to consider for single-threaded or storage-intensive tasks.
